backup.production_rule: verified_at is the backup creation time. Additive: two function bodies replaced with the same signatures, SELECT grants and read policies added on eight tables. No data touched. Apply within one hour of the backup or take a new one.

forward_verification.name: management_owner_authorized_has_no_aal_clause
forward_verification.query: select prosrc not like '%aal2%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='management_owner_authorized'

forward_verification.name: eight_staff_read_policies_exist
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 8 from pg_policies where schemaname='public' and policyname in ('airbnb_reservations_staff_read','booking_inquiries_staff_read','calendar_events_staff_read','calendar_sync_log_staff_read','booking_decisions_staff_read','job_heartbeats_staff_read','concierge_handoffs_staff_read','staff_access_audit_manage_read')

rollback.safe_until: always - no data is touched; the script restores both function bodies and drops the added grants and policies

feature_flags.name: admin_mfa_step
feature_flags.required_state: the new admin build removes the authenticator step and the client-side MFA gate in the same release; the legacy admin never used aal2. Applying this migration alone only stops finance and staff actions from being refused on password sessions.

compatibility.evidence: Rehearsed 2026-09-13 on cascade-supabase-20260913T072349Z (post admin_modernisation_backend): migration applied, 10/10 forward checks, pgTAP admin_access_simplification 12/12, accounting_foundation_v1 24/24, inventory_movement_compat_v1 10/10, admin_read_models_v1 21/22, staff_roles_and_sessions 20/23, privacy_requests_and_holds 47/49, payment_review_queue 14/15. Every remaining failure asserts anon or service_role privileges, which the --no-acl backup cannot carry into a rehearsal copy (verified: all fail identically without this migration); none concerns authenticated staff.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
the rehearsal with the aal-related pgTAP suites has not passed against the same migration bytes
